## Standing operator rules
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.”
- Run “Webhook v1 to v2 cutover” between other work, in order: 1) `psql -h db-prod -U payments -d payments -c "CREATE TABLE webhook_cutover_20250308 AS SELECT * FROM webhook_cursors WHERE name='primary';"` 2) `curl -fsS https://payments.example.com/v2/health?cutover=20250308` 3) deploy v2.8.1 4) switch `webhook-public` to v2 5–7) create replay jobs A/B with the specified cursor ranges 8) query `webhook_delivery_status`.
- “Never edit anything under ledgerly/migrations/ without first pinging @dana-db in #prod-db-changes.”
- “Heads up: the staging database moved to db-stg-2.internal last week. db-stg-1 is a decommissioned read-only replica; config/staging.yaml is stale. Always use db-stg-2.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Recent work
PDF export migration is paused; priority is the JPY rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py`. Invoice and ledger annotations were added, `build_invoice_lines` now returns a concrete list, totals retain percentage discount behavior, and ledger timestamps are timezone-aware. Exact final test output: `python -m pytest tests/billing -q` → `34 passed in 0.52 seconds`. `git diff --check` reported no whitespace errors. Webhook cutover steps 1–3 are complete; step 4 is next.
